messages:
ava_finance: Quick flags
- AWS Marketplace invoice (Jun) shows a proration mismatch for reseller seat renewals; reseller discounts not prorated for mid-cycle seat changes. Estimated impact ~$4,320 across 3 partners.

kevin_billing: I pulled the assembly logs. We changed proration logic during the May pricing experiment (PR#1442) to simplify monthly proration and it no longer considers `reseller_change_date`.

kevin_billing: snippet from billing job: `if pricing_experiment_v2: prorate = flat_month; else: prorate = prorate_by_day`

lina_partners: Partners will notice higher net charges. Which partners are affected?

ava_finance: Affected: partner-A123, partner-B772, partner-C009. Totals per partner: 1500, 1320, 1500 respectively.

tom_revops: This came from a price experiment toggle rollout, right? We should revert the toggle for reseller flows and issue credits. Tom approves manual credits up to $5k total for incident remediation.

kevin_billing: Confirmed the toggle. I'll open rollback PR and schedule an urgent reassemble. Created ticket BILL-4410. Reassemble window: 2026-07-05 01:30 UTC.

marketplace-bot: Marketplace advisory: "If marketplace proration experiment toggles are used, ensure reseller_change_date is preserved for reseller flows" (automated).

ava_finance: Good. Action items: 1) roll back toggle for reseller path; 2) reassemble invoices and request back-adjust if marketplace supports; 3) otherwise issue manual credits and draft partner comms. Kevin, loop in Accounting for ledger entries.

lina_partners: I'll draft partner notes. Prefer to wait until reassemble confirms amounts, but start outreach template.

kevin_billing: Rollback PR opened: billing/PR-1691. Tagging @tom_revops for approval on reassemble.

tom_revops: Approve reassemble and credits up to $5k. Recording approval in finance-approvals doc.

ava_finance: Thanks all. Please post reassemble results here when done and attach the final credit memos.
